notes.subject: זֻלּוּת
notes.rationale: Hapax; root זול 'be light/contemptible': 'vileness/cheapness' vs older 'shaking (tempest)'; rendered as contemptible-worthlessness.

notes.subject: olgeta rot
notes.rationale: סביב is 'around/every side', an adverb of circuit — rendered as 'on every path/road' in Tok Pisin.

notes.subject: זלות
notes.rationale: Occurs only here in the Tanakh.

translation: Olgeta rot, ol man nogut i wokabaut wantaim, taim man ol i lukim olsem nating i go antap long ol pikinini bilong man.

tokens.gloss: man ol i lukim olsem nating
